subject: Current water situation for the Ledges!
comment:

Question: 1.) What is our current water situation in the Ledges Community off of HWY 18?

2.) Do we have enough water for the new construction to the south of us being developed especially if we ever have a large fire? Very concerned after what happened in So. California.

Thank you so much!
Sincerely,
John Sopko

subject: Public Comments Form
comment:
Regarding February 6, 2025 meeting. Ordinance #2025-001. Case #2024-PDA-009. Mojave Crossing 107 room hotel.
I am against this hotel being located here because it will be behind my home. This is a senior area and many of us live alone. We walk, bike, and drive golf carts all times of the day and evening. Having a hotel behind our homes will increase crime and people walking through our neighborhood. Many seniors walk with canes, walkers, or are in wheelchairs. Plus, with the street behind our homes noise from cars at all hours will be very disruptive and cars and RVs, etc. will be parking on the street behind our homes. Please do not approve this hotel.

subject: Public Comments Form
comment:
To make the Mojave Crossing hotel acceptable to the residents of neighborhood one in Sunriver St. George, I respectfully request that the developer purchase the lot to the south for overflow parking and dog walking green space.
Or the developer should be required to have a 24 hour security service to patrol the area to ensure that there is no illegal parking and to ensure dogs are not allowed in our neighborhood. The St. George police cannot and should not have to patrol this area.
Sincerely,
Larry Gillham
Lot 2162
